Order consists of amendments to Executive Order 12163 (Part 1-1: sections 1-102, 1-201, 1-301) and related provisions. Executive Order 13118 (1999-03-31) restated Part 1-1 of Executive Order 12163 in full, and Executive Order 13637 (2013-03-08) revoked Executive Order 11958, which an earlier version of the order also amended. Missing: a held source that gives the text of Part 1-1 and section 1-301 of Executive Order 12163 as of 2026-10-14 so each of the 19 units can be compared with the surviving text, and the effective date of each amendment; without them no unit can be dated as performed, superseded or continuing.
